{{Top}}
[[File:Kashyyyk_trees.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Wroshyr trees on Kashyyyk]]
{{Quote|Home is beautiful. There are mountains few and trees endless.|[[Treek/Legends|Treek]], describing the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''tree''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. Large numbers of trees formed [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] on many arboreal [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Trees were a source of [[Wood/Legends|wood]], and were often covered in protective bark,<ref name="The Last Jedi">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref> both of which could be extracted for numerous uses by various individuals. Some trees, such as the [[veshok]] trees of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] yielded sturdy durable wood, while the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], were known to grow to immense sizes. [[Strange tree]]s were a type that could be found on a number of planets. Trees were a source of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], particularly the [[twisted tree]] native to [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]].<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

Trees were usually deeply rooted and strong, and firmly connected to nature, yet they bowed and shifted at the promptings of wind and weather.<ref name="The Last Jedi" /> While the greatest trees could withstand external attack, they were susceptible to rot from within.<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>

'''Arboreal''' [[Species/Legends|species]] lived among forests and trees and were specially adapted to tree living.<ref name="TNEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', p. xii</ref>

==Notable species of trees==

* [[Pine tree]]s were a type of tree found on planets such as [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Krant]]<ref name="SW:GB" /> and [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="HEST">''[[How the Ewoks Saved the Trees: An Old Ewok Legend]]''</ref>
* [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]] of Kashyyyk grew to enormous sizes, and covered large portions of the Wookiee homeworld due to the [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] performed by the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. It was very common for Wookiees to make their homes and other dwellings in the branches and canopies of wroshyr trees.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
* [[Veshok]] trees were native to the planet Mandalore; although they grew slowly,<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> veshok trees covered much of Mandalore's northern hemisphere.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
* [[Galek (tree)|Galek]] trees were another tree originating on Mandalore. These [[Silver/Legends|silver]]-leaved trees were capable of living for centuries, and grew tall over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />
* [[Kuvara tree]]s were native to the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]], where they were harvested for their fruit.<ref name="HC">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>
* [[Manax tree/Legends|Manax trees]] hailed from [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], and were planted across the [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]] of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]].<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>
* [[Massassi tree/Legends|Massassi tree]] were [[Color/Legends|purple]]-barked trees native to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref>''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'' </ref>
{{Flora-stub}}
